assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its exact subject, all equipment, silhouette, layout, proportions, camera, framing and pixel-art detail. Image 2 is ONLY a palette/material/lighting reference from the actual game; DO NOT copy its room, furniture or layout. Revise ONLY the first image's colors and lighting to sit naturally beside the restrained game art in image 2. Reduce saturated cyan/electric blue/orange/yellow strongly. Whites become subdued grey ivory, blue becomes dusty slate blue, teal becomes grey petrol, greens muted sage/olive, orange becomes worn rust/ochre, violet muted grey lavender. Preserve department identity and readable shape contrast. Darker, matte industrial midtones, selective small highlights; not muddy black or monochrome. Remove ALL exterior glow, bloom, colored haze, gradients and cast shadows. Screen glass mostly dark with faint small readable traces; illuminated lenses tiny and subdued. No large glowing surfaces or emissive trim. Preserve glass contents and all fine structure. Background must be genuinely transparent RGBA outside the precise object silhouette, including holes; no opaque checkerboard or backdrop. Output one complete 1536x1024 standalone sprite; do not add floor or room. Keep original design unchanged.
